label: On-site monitoring visit with 100% SDV (longer CRA visit + travel)
source: Derived: monitoring_visit CRA part (price minus travel 300/600/900) x on-site time per visit 1.17/1.35/1.49, + travel. Ratio = ADAMON (Brosteanu 2017, via Klatte 2021 Cochrane MR000051) cumulative on-site time / visits per participant, extensive vs risk-based: 2.1/1.8 (medium risk), 5.2/3.5 (low risk)
notes: Visit frequency stays the design's monitoring_interval_months. ADAMON: 1.8-3.5x more visits per participant with extensive on-site monitoring, so a full-SDV design should normally use a shorter interval (e.g. 1 month)
